parameters.query: select valor as token from configuracao where chave = 'whatsapp_verify_token'

select jsonb_object_agg(chave, valor) as cfg from configuracao
where chave like 'whatsapp%' or chave like 'provador%' or chave = 'url_base_n8n'

update whatsapp_mensagens
   set status = $1::jsonb->>'status', erro = coalesce(nullif($1::jsonb->>'erro', ''), erro)
 where wamid = $1::jsonb->>'wamid' and direcao = 'saida'
returning id

insert into whatsapp_mensagens (wamid, sessao, direcao, tipo, payload, texto, status)
select j->>'wamid', j->>'sessao', 'entrada', j->>'tipo', j->'payload', j->>'texto', 'recebida'
from (select $1::jsonb as j) p
on conflict (wamid) do nothing
returning id, wamid, sessao, texto
